title: eulophia microceras
intro: Eulophia microceras, commonly known as the "Coral-root," is a type of orchid plant native to tropical Africa. This plant has been found to possess various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and snake bites. The therapeutic actions of Eulophia microceras include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antiseptic properties, which make it useful in wound healing and skin conditions. Bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and glycosides, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
